Under the frozen rule: **34 missed fights** and 21 false positives. Missed fights have a median max-window score of 0.0413 against 0.886 for detected ones — they are not marginal near-threshold cases.

Failures concentrate by source video: 34 missed fights span only 12 sources, the largest contributing 9.
